$[your map's name]#netfisch#[your map's type]#[your level data (001^875)]#

Don't forget the extra # at the end.

#141743 27 2006-02-10T16:06:22Z Levinous
Oh. My. F. God. Bless you for making this thread. My life has improved.

Post & Packaging

1. N can be bought for $60 per month from this site here.
2. Email M&R 50 times saying how much N costs, and you will get $20 back for the trouble.
3. Open your 3m x 3m x 3m box with N inside.
4. Remove all excess bubble-wrap inside the box. Note: Bubble-wrap may be tied in a megaton knot, just to keep N safe.
5. IMPORTANT: Never pop any bubbles in the bubble-wrap, if done so, N may be damaged periodically/permanently.
6. Extract the 3.14Mb Floppy Disk and insert it into your CD-ROM Drive.
7. Install N. Note: This may take several weeks.
8. Enjoy your N v0.1 beta.

Basic Rules

1. The meter at the top is your health gauge. Collect mines to refill your health in 2 second doses.
2. Gold kills you. Don't touch it.
3. The drones are just there to help. They will shoot down any gold in their sight.

Hints & Tips

1. When you see a trail of mines leading towards a dead end, collect the last mine to be n00b-trapped. This will make your ninja happy.
2. You will unlock a pose when falling off a ledge at a great height. To see your pose again, fall off another ledge.
3. To unlock overclock mode, press K 1,000 times on 0-0.
4. While playing N if it is going too slow, open 101 N windows to accelerate the speed.

FAQs

Q1. WHT EES MEATNET!!!!
A1. Metanet is a forumer where dozens of friendly users are willing to help you with all your problems.

Q2. I AMM STUK OM A LEVL!!!1 WHT DU I DUU!!
A2. Post in 3-year old threads found in the Intelligent/Philisophical Duscussions Forum.

Q3. HW DU I POSST!!
A3. To post, press the "Add Reply" button.

Q4. WHT DU EYE POSST LIK??!!!1
A4a. You post using as many smilies as possible, as many '1's as possible, and with all-caps on. Repeat [A4a] 50 times.
A4b: Repeat [A4b] 60 times. The members will be more willing to help then.

Q5. HW DU I CRAT ESER LVL!!
A5. To create user levels, look up the userlevels.txt document found in your N folder.

Q6. HW DU EYE JMP!!!!
A6. Press the jump button.

Q7. WHT!! EYE CNT ANDRSTND WHT YOR SANG!! WHT DU EYE DU!!!
A7. I don't understand.

Q8. EYE M LUSIG MY!!!!
A8. ...........................

There is no rounding involved and that using one very common mathmatical principal shows .999... = 1

Quote: Kirby, 2006-09-25T15:08:24Z
I know what the first part is... but the rest is beyond me.
It's an animated compilation of cross-sections obtained through an MRI scan. The man is actually a frozen convict (a cadaver), and he is not being cut up in any way. He's lying face down (so his face would be looking toward the bottom of your screen with the top of his head sticking out of the monitor at you) and the scan progresses from his head to his feet.
So the first thing you see is the top of his head, his brain, and then his neck and throat, and then it moves on down to his upper thorax, where you can see the collar bones and his chest (remember that he's facing down), and those two things on the left and right are his arms. When the muscle retracts away from the center, we're viewing his abdomen, and then the scan progresses down through his pelvis, his legs, and eventually down past his feet.

It's science!

I posted this because the thread was about death, and I found this animation on a website shown to me in a recent lecture I attended in a radiology lab. The convict is dead, hence it relates to death. *shrug*
I was mostly just looking for any excuse to put that .gif in there, cuz it's amazing.

The concept of the Pokmon saga stems from the hobby of insect collecting, a popular pastime in which Pokmon's creator Satoshi Tajiri had enjoyed as a child. Tajiris formula took off in Japan and was adapted (and translated) in 1998 for the American market, with the release of Pokmon Red and Blue. These games allowed players to catch, collect, and train hundreds of creatures, known as Pokmon; and battle them against each other to build their strength. These Pokmon could then evolve into more powerful Pokmon and learn new and stronger techniques. Pokmon never bleed or die in battle, only faint this was a very touchy subject to Tajiri, as he didnt want to further fill the gaming world with "pointless violence".

What is the point in doing it for N? We don't need that, we all know it exists.

Name- MapleStory
Game Type- MMORPG
Web site- nexon.net, then from there you click on 'MapleStory'.
info/description- Putting the frustration, masses of training, floods of n00bs, and lag aside, MS is a pretty fun game. Although not enjoyable for everybody, it is fun in most cases. Pros: Fun and addictive when partying or doing quests with friends, controls are easy to grasp, your job's stats are all in your control.
Cons: Big download size, most of the community are real jerks, easy to make mistakes with job building, you can't run without skills, mostly everything costs a lot of money.
